svg.title: Burrows-Wheeler Transform of the string BANANA$
svg.desc: The seven cyclic rotations of BANANA$ form the rotation matrix on the left. Sorting these rotations lexicographically gives the ordered matrix on the right, whose last column, highlighted in amber, is the BWT output: B N N $ A A A. Row 3 of the ordered matrix equals the original input string BANANA$, so the primary index used for decoding is i=3.
